name: "… put counters on it instead" — the first sentence applies only when the condition is false (Throw from the Saddle, Will of the All-Hunter, Power Plant Worker)
notes: Memory: project_audit_target_changes_nothing_2026-10-11. "Target creature you control gets +1/+1 until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on it instead if it's a Mount." gave the +1/+1 to a Mount as well (and, before that, only to a Mount). When an "instead" sentence replaces the one before it with something that is not a continuous effect, _splitConditionalBranches (insteadOfNothing) now gives the sentence before the negated condition and drops the replacement; the counters are left to the player. Bears get the boost, the Mount and the blocking Giant do not; Power Plant Worker without the other two Workers gets +2/+2. Not for "If a creature … would die this turn, exile it instead" (Malicious Eclipse), which replaces an event.
